text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Thursday it confirmed the ratings of Markborough Properties Inc's first mortgages at BBB(high) with a stable trend.
The debt rating agency said it also confirmed the ratings of the Markborough Properties shopping center portfolio or series A secured debentures at BBB with a stable trend.

In confirming the ratings of Markborough's first mortgages, DBRS said the rating was backed by the financial support provided by the company's major shareholder, the Woodbridge Company, and by the asset disposition program, which is ahead of schedule and designed to reduce debt and strengthen the balance sheet.

In confirming the ratings of the company's series A secured debentures, DBRS said the rating was being carried by the company's covenant and supported by the slowly improving debt service coverage ratio.
